title: Where each TV keeps its tracking switch
sub: The viewing-data (ACR) setting on five platforms, and what stays after you switch it off
footer: Menu names vary by model year. Sources: Consumer Reports (updated Oct 19, 2025), Roku support (June 23, 2026), TCL support, Sony and Samsung support pages; see the guide.

Settings, All Settings, Support, Privacy & Terms, User Agreements

name: howto
title: The ten-minute privacy pass on a new TV
sub: Do these before you sign in to anything
footer: Paths from Consumer Reports (Oct 19, 2025) and the makers' support pages; names change between model years.

items.head: Decline at setup
items.body: Say no to viewing information and interest-based ads on the first-run screens.

items.head: Skip the account
items.body: Create the maker account later, or never, if the apps do not need it.

items.head: Switch off ACR
items.body: Use the path for your brand in the table above.

items.head: Reset the ad ID
items.body: Settings, Privacy, Ads on Google TV; Advertising on Roku.

items.head: Check the voice mic
items.body: Turn off the voice assistant or remote mic if you never use it.

items.head: Go offline if unsure
items.body: Unplug Ethernet, skip Wi-Fi and use a streaming box.
